They use the e-consult software system to request an appointment which is used as a triage system for this extremely busy practice.
During my limited time with Saxonbury this is the only area of concern I have encountered and, as they have only recently transferred to the system back in March’25, I am sure the hard working practice manager will be working on improving the process(the reason for giving 4 rather than 5 stars).
Once through that first process I have found the Centre itself to be extremely clean and well organised.
The staff are some of the best I have ever come across in the NHS - they are extremely caring, professional, and knowledgeable individuals who obviously care deeply about the care they provide their patients - from Health Care workers to Phlebotomists, GPs to Practice Nurses; Wonderful.
